resources.string: A wellness app that supports healthy bedtime habits with real ambience and calming routines. It does not diagnose or treat medical conditions.

Jamon ambience tracks are edited from real recordings.

Rain: alex36917 · Freesound 524605 · CC BY
Waves/deep ocean: Luftrum · Freesound 48412 · CC BY
Forest: kvgarlic · Freesound 156826 · CC0 / felix.blume · Freesound 217506 · CC0
Fireplace: ezwa · SoundBible Fireplace · Public Domain
Stream: gluckose · Freesound 333987 · CC0
Thunder rain: Digifish music · Freesound 41739 · CC BY
Crickets: Lisa Redfern · SoundBible 2083 · Public Domain
Night train: SDLx · Freesound 259988 · CC BY 3.0
Fan/air hum: Gravity Sound · Wikimedia Commons · CC BY 4.0

Recordings were trimmed, loop-crossfaded, EQ processed, loudness-normalised and encoded to OGG. Brown, pink and white noise are Jamon-generated spectral noises.
